pages.title: About
pages.text: Countless rocks between Mars and Jupiter. Tier 3 rocket. There is no air. Most of the world is empty, so there is far to fall: gravity is about 10% of Earth's, and the Sun gives off radiation.

pages.title: Landing
pages.text: You descend in an Entry Pod. Bring blocks for a bridge and a grapple: you will have to cross between rocks.

pages.title: Resources
pages.text: Iron, aluminum and ilmenite. Ilmenite gives titanium for the next $(l:space/tech/high_rockets)rocket$() and armor. Crashed probes with useful loot also sit here.
